result.title: The Road to NVIDIA RTX Spark
result.description:
Decades of NVIDIA innovation have led to RTX Spark: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/rtx-spark/

See how we got here—and what comes next for gaming, creating, and building AI locally. Hear from industry leaders at NVIDIA and Microsoft, creators at Corridor Crew, and game developers from CD PROJEKT RED about the breakthroughs behind a new beginning for PCs.

result.title: How NVIDIA AI Is Transforming Chip Design and Manufacturing
result.description:
Demand for advanced chips is accelerating, bringing greater complexity to semiconductor design and manufacturing. See how NVIDIA accelerated computing and AI are helping the industry build the AI-defined fab.

Explore how NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, AI physics models, digital twins, AI agents, and robotics work together to accelerate simulation, optimize the fab, and support engineers and operators. See how NVIDIA Cosmos supports wafer defect classification and how production insights feed back into models to create a continuous cycle of learning and improvement.

From chip design to quality inspection, discover how AI connects people, equipment, and processes across semiconductor manufacturing.

Learn more about NVIDIA solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing: nvidia.com/en-us/industries/semiconductor

Learn how NVIDIA and semiconductor leaders are advancing AI across chip design and manufacturing for AI-defined fabs: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-and-semiconductor-leaders-advance-ai-across-chip-design-and-manufacturing-for-ai-defined-labs
